# Virtual College

> > Virtual College delivers affordable, CPD-certified e-learning and compliance training courses for UK organizations across food safety, safeguarding, health & safety, and workplace development.

Virtual College is a UK-based e-learning platform offering accredited compliance courses and training subscriptions for employees and organizations. The platform specializes in food safety, safeguarding children, equality & diversity, and health & safety training, with RoSPA and CPD certifications.

## Key Topics

- CPD Certified Training
- Compliance Training
- Food Safety & Hygiene
- Safeguarding Children
- Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI)
- Health & Safety
- RoSPA Accreditation
- Online Courses
- Workplace Training
- Volume Discounts
- Portable Appliance Testing (PAT)
- HACCP
- Food Handler Certification
- Children Protection
- Netex Learning Platform

## Core Training Courses

- [Complete Compliance Course Catalogue](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses): Complete catalogue of UK compliance courses across multiple sectors
- [Equality, Diversity & Human Rights Training Course](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/equality-diversity-human-rights-training): CPD-certified Equality, Diversity & Inclusion course for employees
- [Equality, Diversity & Inclusion Training for Managers](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/equality-diversity-managers-training): CPD-certified EDI training course for managers and leadership
- [Level 2 Food Hygiene & Safety Course for Catering](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/level-2-food-hygiene-safety-catering-training): RoSPA Assured Level 2 Food Safety & Hygiene course for catering staff
- [Level 3 Food Hygiene & Safety Course for Supervisors](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/level-3-food-hygiene-training): RoSPA Assured Level 3 Food Safety training for food supervisors
- [Food Allergy & Hygiene Training Package](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/level-2-food-hygiene-allergy-training): Food Allergy Awareness & Level 2 Food Safety training package
- [Level 3 Safeguarding Training (Children)](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/level-3-safeguarding-children-training): CPD-certified Level 3 Safeguarding Children training for professionals
- [Level 2 Safeguarding Children Training](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/level-2-safeguarding-children-training): CPD-certified Level 2 Safeguarding Children course with abuse recognition
- [PAT Testing Course](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/courses/pat-testing-training): RoSPA CPD-certified PAT testing course for electrical appliance safety

## Subscriptions & Pricing

- [Online Training Programs for Employees](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/training-package-subscription): Virtual College subscription training packages for employee development
- [Volume Discounts & Bulk Pricing](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/volume-discounts): Volume discounts and bulk pricing for organizational e-learning

## Learning Resources & Guides

- [Learning Resources and Guides](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/resources): Learning resources including podcasts, articles, infographics, and videos
- [What are the 6 Principles of Safeguarding?](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/resources/what-are-the-6-principles-of-safeguarding): Guide to 6 safeguarding principles under the Care Act 2014
- [Food Hygiene vs Food Safety: Key Differences](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/resources/what-is-the-difference-between-food-hygiene-and-food-safety): Educational guide explaining food hygiene vs food safety differences
- [Ladder Safety: Proper Angle & Safety Tips](https://www.virtual-college.co.uk/resources/ladder-angle-safety-tips): Safety guide on proper ladder positioning and accident prevention
